$comment: ADR-071 D11/D12. Ships as a TEMPLATE ONLY -- never written by the stack, a hook, or scripts/install.sh. A human installs this file, verbatim or after review, at /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json (root-owned, chmod 644). See docs/runbooks/managed-floor-install.md for the sudo install, the pre-install verification checklist, and the uninstall path.
